description: The market view: who holds what share of active ads, week by week. `pulse` is the scope's headline numbers (brands, active ads, launches, video and advertorial share). `share` is the top groups' weekly share by company (default), category, platform, country or plan, in active-ad counts (`unit`); a shorter trend window returns fewer weeks and lists `history` in `share.locked`. `categories` is one level of the category tree, largest first, capped by `limit`; drill in with categoryId, which also returns its top companies as `leaders`. Share is of ads Sightglass has seen, not spend or revenue. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

categoryId.description: Scope to one category's subtree; ids come from the `categories` in this tool's result. With a category, `leaders` lists its top companies.

groupBy.description: What to rank by share of active ads: company (default), category, platform, country or plan.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_rankings
title: Get market rankings
